scheduled.headline: Your coach scheduled 3 sessions
scheduled.intro: These sessions are on your calendar.

cancelled.headline: Your 2 sessions were cancelled
cancelled.intro: These sessions are no longer on the calendar. Message your coach if you need other times.

digest.headline: Your CVF PT daily update
digest.intro: Good morning, Casey. Here is what is waiting in the app.
digest.footer: You can turn off daily digests from Email notifications in your account menu. Transactional booking emails remain on.

invite.headline: Your CVF PT account is ready to claim
invite.intro: Sam Coach set up your Core Value Fitness training account. Sign up with this exact email address: casey@example.invalid.
invite.footer: If you were not expecting this, you can ignore this email.

reset.headline: Reset your CVF PT password
reset.intro: Hi Casey — use the button below to choose a new password.
reset.footer: This link expires after about an hour. If you did not request it, you can ignore this email.

long.headline: Your coach scheduled 8 sessions
long.intro: Times vary — see your schedule for each session.
